🚗✨ Build the Future of In‑Vehicle Digital Experiences — Join VASS Romania as an Angular JR Developer 
 Some frontend roles let you build interfaces.This one lets you shape how people interact with their vehicles .
 At VASS Romania, we’re working on cutting‑edge digital experiences for the automotive industry — combining modern Angular applications with next‑generation Android Automotive interfaces that run directly on vehicle touchscreens. It’s a place where engineering meets innovation, and where your work becomes part of the driving experience for thousands of users.
 If you’re passionate about clean code, modern frontend development, and building products that live beyond the browser, this is a journey you’ll want to be part of.
 🚀 What You Will Build 
 You’ll join a multidisciplinary team developing applications that power the infotainment and digital cockpit systems of modern vehicles. Your work will directly influence how drivers interact with navigation, media, connectivity, and vehicle functions.
 You will:
Develop high‑quality Angular applications (90% of the work) used across automotive digital platforms.
Contribute to Android Automotive applications (10%), bringing your UI and UX expertise to in‑vehicle touchscreens.
Collaborate closely with teams in Romania and Germany, participating in design discussions, technical reviews, and feature planning.
Work in an environment where Python will soon be introduced for automated testing in Android Automotive environments — giving you the chance to expand your skill set.
Help shape the frontend architecture, coding standards, and best practices for a product used internationally.
Participate in a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and knowledge sharing.
 🌍 What Makes This Experience Unique 
 Working at VASS Romania means joining a team that values engineering excellence, creativity, and collaboration. You’ll be part of a project that blends:
 Modern web development with real‑world automotive technology
 International teamwork , with daily collaboration with colleagues in Germany
 Innovation , as we explore new tools, frameworks, and testing automation
 Impact , because your code becomes part of the user experience inside vehicles
 This is not just another frontend role — it’s a chance to work on products that people interact with every day, in a context where performance, usability, and reliability truly matter.
 🎯 What You Bring 
 You’re a developer who cares about quality, user experience, and modern engineering practices.
 You have:
1-2 years experience with Angular and modern frontend development.
Good communication skills in English , as much of the collaboration happens with teams in Germany.
Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies — Python knowledge is a plus and will become increasingly valuable.
A mindset focused on clean code, maintainability, and scalable UI architecture.
A collaborative spirit and the ability to work effectively in an international environment.
 ✨ Why Join VASS Romania 
 Because here, you’re not just coding — you’re contributing to a digital transformation in one of the most innovative industries. You’ll work with talented people, modern technologies, and a product that lives inside vehicles, not just browsers.
 If you’re ready to build something meaningful and grow in a team that values your craft, we’d love to meet you.
